async def act(page):
    # Use the knowledge base function to navigate to the project details
    await navigate_to_project_details(page, "The A11Y Project / a11yproject.com")
    # Wait for the page to load after navigation
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Navigate to the commits page for the project
    commits_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Commits", exact=True)
    await commits_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Filter commits by author 'Kilian' and date '2023-03-05'
    # Assuming there are input fields for author and date, adjust selectors as needed
    author_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Author")
    await author_input.fill("Kilian")
    date_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Date")
    await date_input.fill("2023-03-05")
    filter_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Filter")
    await filter_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Extract the count of commits from the page, e.g., from a summary element
    commit_count_element = page.get_by_role("status", name="Commit count")
    commit_count = await commit_count_element.inner_text()
    # Return the count as a string
    return commit_count
